sonnet.q1: The old engine charges and writes the ledger. The new engine's invoices go to the shadow store (never charged, never written to the ledger).
sonnet.q2: The new engine charges and writes the ledger. The old engine keeps computing every invoice into the shadow store without charging, so it stays current.
sonnet.q3: 7 consecutive days with mismatch rate under 0.1 percent and at least 5,000 invoices compared. A person makes the move.
sonnet.q4: The billing monitor seeing the new engine's charge failure rate above 2 percent over any 10-minute window. Only in both or new_only.
sonnet.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only. The rollout then returns to shadow and the gates reset, so the 7-day count starts over (and the 7-day gate must be met again before moving forward).
sonnet.q6: From day 35 in new_only (assumed counted from entering new_only), because the usage event log keeps only 35 days of events for the old engine to reprocess. After that there is no way back.
sonnet.q8: NOT STATED. (The document says the day counts' location is an open question; comparison results are saved in comparison_results. How promotion is blocked is not stated beyond that mismatches block the move to new_only until resolved.)
sonnet.q9: The billing monitor. It watches the new engine's charge failure rate (above 2 percent over any 10-minute window). What it does when the condition is met: it starts an automatic rollback.
sonnet.q10: NOT STATED. Charging is paused in step 1 and resumes in step 5 (old engine charges again), but the document does not say what happens to charges that fall due in between. Reconcile checks that no due charge is dropped.
sonnet.q11: The reconcile step (step 4) checks charges per customer and billing period using the ledger, comparison_results and rollback record, so no period is charged twice. Also retries must not charge anyone twice.
sonnet.q12: Each failed step is retried. Step 1 must succeed before going on. In step 3, if events are missing, stop and tell a person; in step 4 any gap goes to a person. The billing state left in after a partial failure is NOT STATED.
